parchment.$description: Parchment — Primary page background, light surfaces.

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary text, UI icons, primary buttons, borders.

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Hero section text, high-emphasis text elements.

carbon.$description: Carbon — Footer background, secondary dark surfaces.

alabaster.$description: Alabaster — Text on dark backgrounds, rare highlight surfaces.

umber.$description: Umber — Accent text on specific badges; provides a rare, earthy color pop.

suisseintl.$description: The workhorse font for all UI text, body copy, navigation, product titles, and buttons. Its neutrality provides a stable, legible foundation for the more expressive serif.

zapf-humanist.$description: Reserved for major, atmospheric headlines. Its humanist serif form contrasts with the clinical sans-serif, adding an editorial, classic quality.
